description: Two humans are talking near the device; the audio is conversational but the speech is not addressed to the agent. The speak policy must produce silence — NOT a full_response or backchannel — because the utterance is classified as not addressed to the agent. This tests the invariant that proactive speech requires policy approval (invariant #4) and that silence wins ties (invariant #8) when addressee confidence is below threshold.

fixture_conventions.skeleton_note: Per-frame signal values are placeholders. Finalize at Stage 3 activation when the addressee-classification adapter and its confidence threshold are specified.
fixture_conventions.addressee_p_self: Scripted probability [0.0, 1.0] that the utterance is addressed to the agent. < threshold => NOT_ADDRESSED_TO_AGENT branch fires.
fixture_conventions.addressee_threshold: Placeholder — to be set at Stage 3 activation (expected ~0.5).
fixture_conventions.expected_action_class: silence — the agent must not speak when not addressed.
fixture_conventions.frame_duration_ms: 32 — to be confirmed at Stage 3 activation.
fixture_conventions.expected_events_markers: event_type strings are fixture-internal role labels, not Part 5 event_type values.
